source.platform: Steam (stated in the stream title; not visually verifiable)
source.discovery_copy: yt-dlp format 134 (640x360 h264 30 fps); source maximum is 720p60
source.overlay_family: chat column (right edge) + channel logo (bottom-right corner)
source.overlay_status: whole stream: a chat column covers the right edge and a small logo the bottom-right corner (measured on 720p frames: chat column starts at ~0.875W and the logo is in the bottom-right corner, both outside the result ROI)

coverage.structure: all 644 ten-second contact thumbnails (0-6430 s) reviewed visually and 31 matches delimited from them
coverage.interval_ends: 31 of 31 match ends reviewed as 2 fps central-band strips (34-44 s windows around each end)
coverage.status: complete structural coverage; all 31 events second-verified on the 720p60 copy
coverage.verification_method: native 720p60 (format 298; source maximum) central-band crop at each banner midpoint: 30/31 legible and matching; IX-12 midpoint (2150.75 s) fell on a 2-frame flicker dip and was verified on 10 fps and 60 fps 720p strips (YOU WIN 2149.6-2152.5 s)
coverage.known_annotation_limits: 2 fps strip labels can lead the shown frame by up to ~0.3 s; bounds are +/-0.5 s
